title: File-scope constraint blocks an otherwise passing candidate
evidence: engine/verify.py:parse_review; PR #331 requirements[16]; task #330
cause: Source-quote schema is applied to a constraint whose proof is the changed-file inventory.
solution: Type evidence as source, diff_scope, command, authority or publication; verify scope deterministically from exact base/candidate diff.
accept: Replay #330: one allowed file passes scope proof; adding any second file fails; no model quote needed.

title: Passing suite can certify tests of copied logic
evidence: PR #323 diff; docs/phase3/issue-log.md:P3-131; engine/requirements.py:matrix
cause: Test citation and suite success do not establish execution of the production behavior.
solution: Require production imports/calls plus independent negative controls or mutation tests for changed behavior.
accept: Original #323 inline-copy test is rejected; a wrong production implementation makes the replacement test fail.

title: Workflow success differs from objective completion
evidence: Run 41115534131 success; PR #331 incomplete; checkpoint testing
cause: Workflow exit code reports controller execution rather than delivered objective state.
solution: Emit separate controller, validation and objective conclusions with a terminal receipt consumed by UI and workflows.
accept: Green workflow plus blocked review renders blocked, never completed, in API and UI.

title: Requirement extraction silently drops work after 30 entries
evidence: engine/requirements.py:split MAX_REQUIREMENTS; audit probe 40 inputs yields 30
cause: Fixed prefix cap has no overflow failure or decomposition receipt.
solution: Detect overflow, preserve all original requirements and page/decompose with stable IDs.
accept: 40 explicit requirements produce 40 tracked IDs or a visible nonterminal overflow; none disappear.

title: Sparse budget updates discard previously spent counters
evidence: engine/budget_ledger.py:Ledger.record; audit probe calls+bytes then calls drops bytes
cause: Dictionary rebuilt only from incoming keys.
solution: Merge into prior totals monotonically, preserving omitted keys.
accept: Persist calls=10 bytes=100 then calls=11; restart retains bytes=100 and calls=11.

title: Budget record input is not sanitized like saved input
evidence: engine/budget_ledger.py:Ledger.record versus __init__
cause: Only loaded values filter types and nonnegative values; record accepts arbitrary mapping values.
solution: Validate finite numeric nonnegative counters and string keys at both ingress points.
accept: Reject booleans, strings, NaN, infinity, negative values and non-string keys without corrupting prior spend.

title: Patch mismatch and unchanged proposals recur across nominally distinct strategies
evidence: Task #322 recovery events: reread_source and smaller_stages repeat; engine/developer.py:generate_with
cause: Strategy labels do not demonstrate changed causal conditions.
solution: Persist normalized failure family, source version, attempted hypothesis and evidence delta; prohibit repeat without new evidence.
accept: Replay #322 emits no same-anchor edit against the same source after its first failure; later action reads exact lines or changes edit method.

title: Latest malformed-tool recovery lacks live acceptance evidence
evidence: engine/tool_loop.py; PR #327; #322 invalid_limit; #330 did not enter repair
cause: Parser/cap improvement tested locally but the historical failed workflow was not repeated on current runtime.
solution: Run isolated recorded-response replay and later an explicitly authorized live repair; retain stop reasons and candidate tests.
accept: A truncated reply, fenced object and singleton list recover and finish a genuine failing-import repair without changing task scope.

title: Recovery must reconcile closed drafts and obsolete goals before inference
evidence: Task #322 run 41114997477: No open pull request; #323 closed unmerged; engine/recovery.py
cause: Saved authority/candidate state can outlive the actionable draft.
solution: Reconcile issue, PR state, branch, candidate and already-shipped behavior before any generation; terminal superseded/cancelled outcome.
accept: Closed #323 produces zero model/tool writes and a precise superseded or owner-decision receipt.

title: Multiple retry ceilings do not encode five meaningful strategies
evidence: developer.py:generate_with max_attempts=5; sandbox_repair_controller.py MAX_ATTEMPTS=20 MAX_MODEL_ACTIONS=100; recovery.py limits
cause: Proposal retries, sandbox attempts and continuations have different semantics and budgets.
solution: Unify lifetime budget accounting; default at most five evidence-changing repair strategies, category-specific transient waits separate.
accept: Exhaustion across restart preserves all budgets; 429 waits do not consume repair strategies; no repeated side effects.

title: Initial generation and sandbox repair remain separate execution protocols
evidence: developer.py:select_files,generate_with,run_sandbox_repair; exploration.py; tool_loop.py
cause: Initial code is proposed from assembled context; dynamic tools exist in investigation and repair rather than one uniform loop.
solution: Introduce typed action/observation runtime shared by planning, editing, tests and review; retain current adapters during migration.
accept: A task discovers an unplanned dependency, reads it, edits, tests and replans through one durable event contract.

title: Tool history is clipped rather than semantically compacted
evidence: engine/tool_loop.py:history[-30000:] and _bounded_result 3000 chars; controller histories bounded
cause: Text tails can omit the original cause and prior ineffective strategies.
solution: Keep immutable receipts externally; construct context from active goal, current evidence, failed hypotheses and retrievable result IDs.
accept: After >30k history the next action still respects first failure and can retrieve omitted output.

title: String find/replace is a fragile edit interface
evidence: engine/sandbox_tools.py:apply_patch; developer.py:apply_changes; #322 anchor mismatches
cause: Model must reproduce exact text from excerpts; no generalized semantic patch transaction.
solution: Provide versioned line/unified-diff patches with expected file digest and explicit conflict observations; retain exact-match safe fallback.
accept: Formatting and stale-source fault fixtures trigger reread/rebase, never repeated blind replacement or silent wrong-file writes.

title: Static planning limits narrow large-project reach
evidence: developer.py MAX_LISTED_PATHS=700 MAX_STAGES=5; read/change budgets
cause: Bounded windows are necessary but coverage is not an exhaustive repository investigation.
solution: Page file/symbol inventory and expose explicit coverage and subgoal expansion under lifetime budgets.
accept: Target past path 700 and dependency past initial source list are found without raising all context caps.

title: General-purpose executor is not exposed through the development-only tool catalog
evidence: engine/tool_loop.py TOOL_CATALOG; chat-backend/src/operation-contract.js
cause: Tools center on sandbox coding, curated docs and app/GitHub operations.
solution: Add permission-scoped capability registry with shared execution receipt and artifact contracts.
accept: One supported task combines research, a file artifact and authorized application operation with verified receipts.

title: NVIDIA priority routes fail in latest live task
evidence: Task #330 gateway receipts: deepseek empty_response; nemotron timeout; inference-router.js
cause: Eligibility and static strong tier do not guarantee useful compatible output.
solution: Add fixture-backed normalization/parameter contracts, route quality health by role and small opt-in canaries; demote unusable routes without hiding errors.
accept: Replay 200-empty, reasoning-only and first-byte timeout; fallback completes, attribution and cooldown reasons remain correct.

title: Conservative admission makes strong fallback routes unusable for ordinary prompts
evidence: Task #330 Groq context_limit, Mistral request_too_large; inference-router.js; docs/phase3/issue-log.md:P3-129
cause: Input/output reservations and conservative token estimates exceed route limits.
solution: Keep safe upper bounds but create route-specific compact prompts and output reserves; validate tokenizer estimates before policy changes.
accept: #330-shaped request admits an eligible compact Groq/Mistral route when within its real limits; oversized requests still fail safely.

title: Model routing is role-ranked policy, not measured task-quality optimization
evidence: config/providers.json routing; routing-policy.js; task330 ranks
cause: Strong/light metadata and route order lack independent task success calibration.
solution: Track verified outcome by model/role/task class with uncertainty and quota-aware selection.
accept: Held-out routing evaluation beats static ordering on completion or latency without paid spend or quality regression.

title: Full deployed provider activation and quota state unavailable
evidence: wrangler.toml keep_vars=true; production dashboard variables inaccessible; task330 only shows attempted subset
cause: Repo configuration cannot establish deployed permission, credentials or remaining quotas.
solution: Publish authenticated sanitized effective-config and deployment/version receipt with no inference.
accept: Owner supplies read-only capabilities/health snapshot covering every provider and policy/version fingerprint.

title: Native tool calling is not the active coding protocol
evidence: config/providers.json nvidia capabilities.tools=false; tool_loop.py JSON envelope; inference-router.js hasTools:false
cause: Application emulates tools with text JSON; native function schemas are not used here.
solution: Retain portable JSON adapter; add tested native-tool adapter only for proven compatible models.
accept: Both adapters pass identical validation/error/cancellation fixtures; unsupported route cannot receive native tool fields.

title: Paid-off default is implemented but current production setting is not audited
evidence: chat-backend/src/premium.js,premium-store.js; routing-policy.js fullCatalog openrouter=false; tests/premium.test.mjs
cause: Persisted owner settings and current account state are not accessible.
solution: Expose sanitized premium enabled flag and reservations; assert default off and last-resort ordering in deployment smoke suite.
accept: Fresh store is OFF; free exhaustion alone cannot charge when OFF; explicit ON obeys task/day caps.

title: Mutable issue comments are the durable control-plane storage
evidence: engine/recovery.py:Journal.persist, multipart checkpoints; execution.py
cause: Checkpoint writes, progress and archive rotation span GitHub API operations without a single atomic transaction.
solution: Add append-only sequence/hash-linked event journal plus CAS state pointer; keep issue comments as export/projection initially.
accept: Kill between each multipart write and pointer update: recover exact validated candidate or explicit incomplete state, never stale success.

title: Recent execution context is deliberately bounded and can lose causal history
evidence: task_state.py INFERENCE_EVENTS=8; project_memory.py paths caps; recovery.py MAX_EVENTS=40
cause: Compact active state is not a permanent evidence ledger.
solution: Separate bounded prompt view from complete retained event and artifact storage with retention policy.
accept: Old failed hypothesis remains retrievable after rotation and restart without entering every prompt.

title: Current engine-pin restart behavior not fault-tested end to end here
evidence: runtime_engine.py; recovery.py engine_pinned; tests/test_runtime_engine.py
cause: Many receipts/renewals guard runtime identity; local unit evidence is insufficient for real interruption coverage.
solution: Create process-kill replay around engine renewal, sandbox save, publication and continuation dispatch.
accept: 20 injected interruption points resume on authorized engine/candidate with no budget reset or duplicate PR.

title: Project memory is a bounded index snapshot rather than durable project understanding
evidence: engine/project_memory.py:snapshot,recent_repo_memory; vector-index.js
cause: Paths/top files and commit IDs do not preserve validated decisions and failure causality as retrievable knowledge.
solution: Separate project facts, decisions and source citations from task journal; invalidate on relevant changes.
accept: Yesterday task resumes with cited decisions and failed approaches; changed source invalidates stale facts.

title: Cross-device sync, deletion and conflict handling lack live device evidence
evidence: preview/app-state.js encrypted vault, revision sync and 500 deletion tombstones
cause: Browser crypto/storage code and tests do not establish device retention or long-term deletion guarantees.
solution: Specify retention and tombstone expiry; test concurrent offline edits, device restore and deletion propagation.
accept: Two devices offline/online do not resurrect deleted chat; export and erase prove server/local removal within declared retention.

title: No general semantic task-context compaction service
evidence: tool_loop.py history clipping; task_state.py MAX_CONTEXT; project_memory.py
cause: Context assembly is distributed across code paths with size limits.
solution: Use evidence-aware summarization retaining goal, constraints, unresolved subgoals, receipts and retrieval IDs.
accept: Long task exceeds context size then resumes with every constraint intact and no repeated failed strategy.

title: General web search and research are absent beyond curated documentation
evidence: config/research-hosts.json; engine/research.py
cause: Allowed search APIs are MDN, npm and ReadTheDocs, not broad current-information research.
solution: Add optional free-first search adapter with dated citations, source access receipts and explicit unavailable outcomes.
accept: Five held-out research tasks cite fetched sources and distinguish inaccessible or conflicting evidence.

title: No agent-controlled browser session tools
evidence: engine/tool_loop.py catalog; research.py HTTP retrieval
cause: HTTP docs fetch and UI Playwright tests are not an autonomous browser capability.
solution: Optional isolated Playwright/browser worker with per-domain grants, screenshot/DOM observations and approval-bound submit actions.
accept: Navigate dynamic fixture, log in with delegated test credentials, extract data, stop before unauthorized external submit.

title: Document and spreadsheet workflows lack purpose-built adapters
evidence: tool catalog and app attachment/chat paths
cause: Attachments and generated source are not tested PDF/DOCX/XLSX operations.
solution: Add sandbox file/artifact adapters, table parsing and deterministic output verification.
accept: Round-trip fixtures preserve formulas, sheets, document structure and produce downloadable artifacts.

title: General MCP/external connector runtime not found
evidence: engine/tool_loop.py; operation-contract.js; config/repositories.json
cause: Integrations are bespoke; no discovered MCP lifecycle or permission registry.
solution: Implement optional connector adapter with scoped grants, schemas, secret isolation and receipts; avoid mandatory service cost.
accept: One local fake MCP server supports discovery/call/cancel with denied tools never invoked.

title: Desktop/local-device execution is not an implemented agent surface
evidence: ios native bridge and sandbox.py remote runner
cause: Native app bridge is not a general desktop automation or local shell agent.
solution: Optional signed local companion with explicit workspace/network grants; keep cloud-only use supported.
accept: Local test workspace read/edit works; access outside approved root is refused and logged.

title: Sandbox language/dependency profiles are narrower than arbitrary projects
evidence: engine/sandbox.py profiles, dependency_plan and command validation
cause: Constrained Python/Node-oriented runners deliberately reject unsupported commands and installs.
solution: Declare supported runtimes; add versioned image/profile adapters on demand with isolated installers.
accept: Unsupported ecosystem identified before generation; supported pinned fixtures restore and test offline.

title: Real Docker isolation was not executed in this audit environment
evidence: sandbox.py flags; local Python skips; Docker CLI unavailable
cause: No local Docker daemon/client evidence; existing production receipts prove tests ran but not hostile escape resistance.
solution: Run sandbox-selftest in disposable approved runner and adversarial network/env/host filesystem tests.
accept: No secrets, Docker socket, host files or network visible to test commands; time/memory/process limits enforced.

title: Generated workflow proposals can execute before owner merge review
evidence: KAPPA.md workflow policy; developer.py:push_token; .github/workflows/agent.yml
cause: Draft status and no-auto-merge do not stop branch/workflow_dispatch execution with repository secrets.
solution: Separate trusted orchestrator from candidate workflows; forbid secret-bearing execution from candidate refs until explicit workflow approval; use least-privilege installation tokens.
accept: Malicious draft workflow attempting secret exfiltration never receives secrets or privileged token before explicit gate.

title: Persisted preferences contain historical authority broader than current owner policy
evidence: .kappaforge/owner-preferences.md owner authorization 2026-10-27; KAPPA.md versus current audit constraints
cause: Versioned natural-language instructions can outlive task-specific authorization.
solution: Treat repository prose as untrusted preferences only; exact expiring grants in control plane govern consequential actions.
accept: Historical auto-merge text cannot authorize a new task; policy contradictions surface as diagnostics.

title: Shared bearer credential persists in browser localStorage
evidence: preview/app-state.js access=localStorage.getItem; index.js Bearer authentication
cause: Single-owner simplicity increases impact of browser script compromise/device extraction.
solution: Use short-lived session credentials and secure native storage or HttpOnly session where feasible; device revocation and strong CSP.
accept: Revoked device token fails; injected script cannot read long-lived privileged credential in browser test.

title: Prompt-injection defense not independently adversarially validated
evidence: tool_loop.py untrusted-output warning; sandbox.py; intent_guard.py
cause: Prompt warnings plus path guards do not demonstrate resistance across model output and privileged GitHub operations.
solution: Add adversarial fixture corpus for repo docs, comments, web pages and test output with controller-side authority checks.
accept: Zero unauthorized writes, paid calls, merge/deploy or secret disclosures in the security benchmark and fuzz cases.

title: Deployed secret scopes, branch protections and environment gates unavailable
evidence: agent.yml, deploy-chat.yml cloudflare-production; configured PAT reference
cause: Workflow declarations do not establish actual PAT scope or production environment approval settings.
solution: Collect read-only sanitized permission inventory and enforce environment approvals before deploy/release.
accept: Owner verifies least privileges and deployment gate rejects unapproved release; audit record contains no values.

title: Cancellation races across running tools and publication need proof
evidence: task-cancellation.js; engine/intent_guard.py; sandbox.py timeout removal
cause: Checks exist but end-to-end cancellation during each side effect was not executed.
solution: Use cancellation epoch on every tool/publish claim and actively terminate child sandbox execution.
accept: Cancel at model wait, patch, test, push and dispatch boundaries; no later consequential action starts.

title: Retention and privacy boundaries differ across vault, issue journals and provider prompts
evidence: app-state.js vault; recovery.py issue comments; runner.py model requests
cause: Encrypted chat backup does not encrypt GitHub task evidence or provider-bound source.
solution: Publish data-flow policy and per-tool redaction/retention controls; prohibit private context in public issues.
accept: Privacy fixtures verify secret redaction and correct private-code provider restrictions; deletion procedure covers every store.

title: Task state can remain testing after runner has finished with incomplete review
evidence: Task #330 checkpoint status testing; run completed 19:36:14Z; PR incomplete
cause: No canonical terminal reconciliation updates every projection.
solution: Finalize durable objective state even on review block, then publish UI projection with sequence and heartbeat.
accept: #330 replay ends blocked_verification with accurate finished time and resume action; no indefinite active timer.

title: Native composer keyboard failure remains open
evidence: PR #317: editor maxY 601, keyboard minY+14 232.333; ios UI tests; issue #313
cause: Existing layout test failed; no root cause confirmed in this audit.
solution: Inspect native simulator artifact and bridge/layout geometry; repair without weakening keyboard assertions.
accept: Same device/orientation reproducer passes composer-above-keyboard assertion and four other existing UI tests.

title: Task progress is polling-based with freshness limits
evidence: preview/app-tasks.js 10-second poll and freshness refresh; progress_notes.py
cause: Progress comments and frontend timing can diverge after delays/offline periods.
solution: Backend event sequence, heartbeat and terminal reconciliation; optional SSE transport, polling fallback.
accept: Out-of-order/duplicate events never regress state; offline reconnect reflects terminal backend state within 15 seconds.

title: UI implementation relies on classic-script shared globals and mirrored bundles
evidence: KAPPA.md Application; preview/index.html; scripts/bundle-web.py
cause: Load-order dependencies and generated copies increase integration risk.
solution: Gradually introduce explicit modules/state contracts while preserving shared bundle checks.
accept: Web/iOS generated assets match; initialization-order and restored-session tests pass after each module migration.

title: Apple-style refinement and real-device accessibility not assessed
evidence: preview styles; ios UI; local web syntax tests
cause: No interactive device session or visual/accessibility execution in this audit.
solution: Run existing browser suite and targeted real-device keyboard, touch, VoiceOver and offline checks.
accept: Document screenshots and accessibility results for agreed device sizes with no critical interaction blockers.

title: No measured general-purpose 50-task autonomy benchmark
evidence: tests unit suites; tools/lifecycle_simulation.py narrow coding harness
cause: Unit counts and prior simulation passes are not independent broad workload outcomes.
solution: Implement the 50-task protocol in report 08 with hidden acceptance and task-level receipts.
accept: All tasks have actual results or unsupported outcomes; aggregate metrics computed from raw records.

title: Local passing suites leave important integrations skipped
evidence: Audit Python 1452 run, 36 skipped; Docker/native/structural tooling unavailable locally
cause: Optional infrastructure checks are not exercised by the local suite.
solution: Report skips by capability; require dedicated integration gates with available infrastructure.
accept: Critical integration gate cannot pass when all real runtime tests are skipped.

title: Dependency-map freshness is warning-only in CI
evidence: tests.yml dependency-map --check || warning
cause: Stale context index may ship even when code imports change.
solution: Generate deterministically and make freshness a required check or serve on-demand versioned index.
accept: Import change without regenerated index fails check; index carries matching SHA.

title: Production SLOs, incidents and long-window objective success unavailable
evidence: Actions run history; no supplied production telemetry or owner session traces
cause: Workflow status cannot measure task completion, latency, availability or false success.
solution: Instrument task objective outcomes, route health, queue latency, recoveries, false-success audits and versioned SLO reports.
accept: 30-day report has denominators, exclusions and incident causes; objective success is separately reported from run success.

title: Current browser/Worker runtime and native build not fully executed locally
evidence: tests.yml workerd and Playwright jobs; local audit check-web/build evidence
cause: Syntax and dry-run do not establish interactive or runtime behavior.
solution: Execute existing workerd recovery check, Chromium/WebKit and macOS native suite in isolated CI.
accept: Exact-head receipts include browser, runtime and native results with artifact hashes and skips.

title: Deployed Worker SHA and dashboard-managed policy not independently matched
evidence: wrangler.toml keep_vars; deploy-chat.yml; latest route receipts
cause: Engine main SHA is known, deployed Worker version/config fingerprint is not.
solution: Return build SHA and redacted effective policy hash in authenticated health responses; archive deploy receipt.
accept: A task receipt identifies engine, Worker, policy and candidate versions end to end.

title: Push-to-main deployment couples code acceptance to production rollout
evidence: deploy-chat.yml push trigger and cloudflare-production environment
cause: Main merges can deploy Worker without an independently confirmed owner deployment decision unless environment gates enforce it.
solution: Require explicit release authorization or protected environment approval with exact artifact digest; keep dry-run CI separate.
accept: Merge alone cannot deploy/release under current owner policy; approved exact build can roll back to prior version.

title: Background autonomy is constrained by Actions and expiring task authority
evidence: recovery.yml schedule; agent.yml timeouts; recovery.py continuation limits
cause: Actions scheduling and finite grants are not a general durable calendar/reminder service.
solution: Expose supported schedules and expiry; optional DO alarm/queue coordinator with idempotent leases and owner-approved job scope.
accept: A scheduled test job survives coordinator restart; expired authorization blocks side effects and asks renewal once.

title: Limited stage parallelism is not independent multi-agent execution
evidence: developer.py:waves MAX_PARALLEL_WORKERS=3; shared task context
cause: Disjoint-file waves alone do not prove workspace isolation, semantic conflict resolution or aggregate budget safety.
solution: Keep serial default; permit optional isolated researcher/test/reviewer workers with explicit read/write sets and reconciliation.
accept: Parallel independent fixtures reconcile cleanly; overlapping edits serialize; one child failure cannot corrupt parent state.

title: README presents obsolete capability and permission restrictions as current
evidence: README.md Current capability(v0.1), v0.2 sandbox, self-repair sections versus current developer.py
cause: Append-only milestone documentation contains mutually incompatible descriptions.
solution: Publish one versioned current capability table and move historical release descriptions to history.
accept: Every current capability links to implementation and exact validation; unsupported claims are visibly labeled.

title: All historical branches and PR descriptions not exhaustively inspected
evidence: 273 branches discovered; 100 recent PR metadata; six open PR changed-file inventories
cause: Large retained development history exceeds the inspected active surfaces; unassociated branches may contain material work.
solution: Triage branch ancestry and last commit date, classify owner-active branches, inspect material divergences and archived PR context.
accept: Every active divergent branch has owner/status, changed components and effect on audit; stale branches clearly excluded.

title: Task #330 test omits assertion for a required invalid key type
evidence: PR #331 tests/test_budget_ledger.py:test_ignores_invalid_saved_values
cause: Fixture includes key 123 but assertions only check string keys.
solution: Add direct assertion against retained prior/totals keys and negative controls for each required invalid type.
accept: Mutation that accepts non-string keys makes the new test fail while real implementation passes.

title: Multimodal understanding/output coverage is not demonstrated
evidence: chat-backend/src/voice.js; providers.js media metadata; app attachments
cause: Voice/media transport is not evidence of document/image reasoning across active free models.
solution: Define supported MIME/capability routes and fixture-based grounding tests; reject unsupported formats accurately.
accept: Image/audio fixtures yield verified grounded outputs on allowed models or explicit unsupported state without fabricated inspection.

title: Duplicated recovery and authority surfaces increase change risk
evidence: runner.py fallback path; inference-router.js; intent_guard.py and intent-guard.js; actions_log.py and actions-core.js
cause: Cross-language twins and legacy/current paths require synchronized contracts.
solution: Keep platform adapters but share schemas, conformance fixtures and one transition/receipt specification.
accept: Same adversarial and transition corpus yields equivalent decisions in Python, Worker and frontend.

title: Sample contains failed/cancelled runs but broad recovered outcomes are not independently graded
evidence: 100 agent runs; #308 many green Fix runs; #319 cancelled; report11
cause: Survivorship avoided in selection, but status-only records cannot prove task-level recovery or intervention counts.
solution: Grade sampled objectives against immutable requests/artifacts; include tasks without PRs and all retry chains.
accept: Random task sample reports first-attempt/recovery/human intervention with task denominator and missing-evidence count.
